baseline_models.mechanism: Wind is organized into two equal, named legs: morning departure and evening return, each measured as a month. Atmospheric force therefore becomes a scheduled bidirectional transport cycle rather than undirected speed.

activation_trace.role: Wind and moving air supply the mobile medium of the cycle.
Evening travel and return give the second leg its temporal and directional closure.
Morning departure fixes the first leg at the opening of the day.
The repeated known month supplies equal quantitative range to both legs.

changed_reading.before: A spectacularly fast wind makes two long trips.
changed_reading.after: The wording encodes a measured alternating mobility regime whose outward and return legs are synchronized as equal month-range movements.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَأَسَلْنَا لَهُ عَيْنَ ٱلْقِطْرِ وَمِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ مَن يَعْمَلُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ
baseline_models.mechanism: Causative flow, a spring-like source, molten copper, and labor before the ruler form a source-to-workshop chain. Hidden agents become materially legible through ordered production.

activation_trace.role: Running flow supplies the process that makes the material continuously available.
A flowing spring supplies a concentrated source rather than scattered material.
Molten copper identifies the supplied stream as workable metal.
Hidden beings provide the otherwise unseen laboring agents.
Intentional work converts supplied material into purposeful production.
The before-hands construction places production in a supervised presence.

changed_reading.before: A copper spring and a jinn workforce are two separate favors.
changed_reading.after: They read as one integrated foundry: a supplied liquid-metal source passes into supervised hidden labor and manifest output.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِ وَمَن يَزِغْ مِنْهُمْ عَنْ أَمْرِنَا نُذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
baseline_models.mechanism: Authority is nested: Solomon benefits from service, but the Lord licenses it, the divine command defines its path, and deviation activates embodied sanction. The grant is delegated governance, not autonomous sovereignty.

activation_trace.role: Permission and licensing bound every subordinate act.
Lordship supplies the superior ownership and sovereignty behind the grant.
Deviation is a directional departure from an established straight course.
Binding command supplies the norm from which a worker can depart.
Tasting turns breach into personally experienced consequence.
Punitive pain gives the sanction its judicial force.
Kindled blaze supplies the sanction's consuming material image.

changed_reading.before: Solomon commands a coerced workforce by exceptional personal power.
changed_reading.after: His command space exists only inside divine license, and each worker remains individually answerable to the higher command.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: عَيْنَ ٱلْقِطْرِ وَمِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ مَن يَعْمَلُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَمَن يَزِغْ نُذِقْهُ
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus repeatedly externalizes what is concealed: hidden beings work in front, an eye/source emits visible metal, and invisible deviation becomes tasted consequence.

activation_trace.role: Concealment supplies the hidden pole of the scene.
The eye branch supplies an exploratory image of visibility within the material source.
Being before the hands places concealed labor in an exposed relational field.
Experienced tasting makes an otherwise abstract breach bodily legible.

changed_reading.before: Unseen servants simply perform assigned tasks.
changed_reading.after: The scene is also a disclosure apparatus: hidden agency becomes knowable through visible work, position before authority, and embodied consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired motions of 34:2, entry and exit from earth and descent and ascent through heaven, activate a circulation grammar around the focus. Its morning/evening wind and flowing metal become horizontal and material channels inside a larger ordered field of movement known by God.

activation_trace.role: Entry into an interior supplies the inward vector of the circulation pair.
Passage outward supplies the balancing exit vector.
Descent supplies the downward vertical channel.
Ascent supplies the upward return channel.
The focus's flowing metal realizes ordered circulation in a material register.

structural_cues: 34:2 balances entry with exit and descent with ascent; 34:12 balances morning with evening and couples transit to material flow.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two balanced motion lists; I infer a shared circulation grammar. A live alternative is that the symmetry is rhetorical and does not imply one integrated system.

changed_reading.before: The wind is an isolated vehicle and the copper an isolated material miracle.
changed_reading.after: Both participate in a measured circulation system whose directional flows remain inside divine knowledge and ordering.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated uses of the before-hands construction span surrounding space, textual precedence, and impending punishment. This widens the jinn's position before Solomon from court placement into an exposed horizon where prior order and coming consequence are both present.

activation_trace.role: The focus locates labor directly before an authority.
The interval between hands and behind forms a surrounding field open to inspection.
What lies before the hands supplies the visible forward field.
What lies behind completes the spatial enclosure around the observer.
The same construction extends forward presence into textual precedence.
A punishment before the hands extends the construction into imminence.

structural_cues: The construction occurs at 34:9, 34:12, 34:31, and 34:46 with spatial, textual, and anticipatory scopes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated construction; I infer resonance across its scopes. A live alternative is that each occurrence is a conventional idiom with no designed cross-activation.

changed_reading.before: The jinn merely work physically in front of Solomon.
changed_reading.after: Their work occurs in an accountability horizon: exposed before authority, continuous with prior order, and facing consequence already set before them.

context_deltas.mechanism: David's hard iron is softened and then constrained by measured, connected fabrication; Solomon's copper is liquefied and hidden workers are constrained by permission and command. The paired sequence is enable material, calibrate process, and inspect work.

activation_trace.role: Softness against rough resistance supplies the enabling material transformation.
Hard iron supplies the resistant material made workable.
Deliberate estimation supplies process planning and calibrated limits.
Connected succession supplies an ordered fabrication pattern.
Repeated intentional work joins craft instruction, moral output, and inspection.
Molten copper supplies Solomon's parallel transformation of resistant matter.

structural_cues: 34:10-11 immediately precedes 34:12; each gift alters a metal and immediately binds making to ordered work.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies juxtaposed metal transformations and work clauses; I infer a shared craft-governance pattern. They can still remain separate gifts rather than one technical program.

changed_reading.before: Flowing copper is primarily a display of abundance.
changed_reading.after: It is the feedstock side of calibrated craft governance, paired with softened iron and bounded by measured process, authorization, and inspected work.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next scene converts generic work into durable public-scale objects and then names the required human work as gratitude. Saba's provision-and-thanks formula confirms that productive abundance seeks an ethical return, not output alone.

activation_trace.role: Repeated intentional work links jinn production to the command addressed to David's household.
Fixed, rooted cauldrons turn mobile material into stable infrastructure.
Recognition of the benefaction names the proper moral product of work.
Allocated provision places abundance inside a giver-recipient relation.
The repeated demand for gratitude generalizes the response owed for provision.
The focus's binding command anchors gratitude back in obedient production.

structural_cues: 34:13 follows the focus with a product list and the imperative to work as gratitude; 34:15 repeats provision followed by gratitude.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies neighboring work and gratitude imperatives; I infer that material obedience is meant to become grateful service. A live alternative is that the ethical command applies only to David's household and frames, rather than defines, jinn labor.

changed_reading.before: The command keeps an extraordinary workforce productive.
changed_reading.after: The production system is ethically incomplete until mobile gifts settle into useful stability and their beneficiaries answer abundance with grateful work.

context_deltas.mechanism: Solomon's death is not indicated until a creeping creature consumes the support and his fall discloses the truth. The hidden workers then prove unable to know the hidden. Their extraordinary status is therefore sharply separated from access to unseen knowledge.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies hidden beings as the commanded workforce.
Indication by a sign supplies the missing disclosure of death.
Loss of life creates the concealed state that the workers fail to detect.
Creeping on earth supplies the small material agent that erodes the support.
The audible, unstable fall converts concealed death into public evidence.
The same hidden beings become the subjects of epistemic exposure.
Disclosure to a knower marks the knowledge they demonstrably lacked.
What is screened from eyes defines the domain denied to the jinn.

structural_cues: 34:14 gives a causal sequence: concealed death, unnoticed erosion, fall, disclosure, and the counterfactual denial of jinn knowledge of the unseen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence; I infer that Solomon's visible standing mediated labor discipline while divine permission sustained the hierarchy. A live alternative is that the verse only denies jinn knowledge without explaining the mechanism of continued labor.

changed_reading.before: Command over jinn displays mastery of the unseen.
changed_reading.after: The workforce is itself demystified: hidden agents can be organized visibly while remaining ignorant of the unseen and dependent on a higher authorization.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same flow root that supplies molten copper returns as Saba's flood after the command to give thanks is refused. A restrained channel becomes a landscape-replacing force, making flow a governed threshold between productive release and destructive release.

activation_trace.role: The causatively released flow feeds productive metalwork in the focus.
Grateful recognition supplies the ethical condition immediately before the reversal.
Turning one's side away supplies the relational switch preceding destructive flow.
The repeated root now realizes flow as an overwhelming flood.
A barrier that holds back floodwater supplies the image of breached restraint.
One thing replacing another supplies the flood's irreversible material consequence.

structural_cues: 34:15 offers provision and gratitude; 34:16 answers turning away with a flood and substituted gardens.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated flow root and the ethical sequence; I infer a controlled-versus-destructive release contrast. It may remain a narrative analogy rather than a direct hydraulic gloss on the copper.

changed_reading.before: Flowing copper is an unqualified image of abundance.
changed_reading.after: Flow is beneficial only while channeled within right relation: it can feed craft, or cross its threshold and replace an inhabited abundance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured safe routes in 34:18 become deliberately distanced journeys and then fragmentation in 34:19. Against that reversal, Solomon's month-range morning and evening transit reads as bestowed calibration of distance, not conquest of distance for its own sake.

activation_trace.role: Evening travel and return anchor one half of the focus's compressed itinerary.
Repeated months quantify the granted reach of each daily leg.
Deliberate estimation organizes the route into a planned travel system.
Movement and onward travel supply the safely enabled circulation.
Actively producing distance reverses the prior convenience of measured routes.
Travel away from settlement makes the requested distancing operational.
Tearing into scattered pieces gives misused distance its social endpoint.

structural_cues: 34:18 links measured routes to secure night-and-day travel; 34:19 requests greater distance and ends in total dispersal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a calibrated route followed by requested distance and fragmentation; I infer that the focus's compressed itinerary is a permissioned good. A live alternative is that Solomon's wind and Saba's roads are independent travel motifs.

changed_reading.before: The wind simply annihilates ordinary travel time.
changed_reading.after: Its speed is a form of rightly measured access: distance serves circulation when granted and becomes fragmentation when desired as estrangement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Satan has no governing authority except within a divine test; alleged powers own not even an atom, possess no share, and intercession works only by permission. These denials sharpen the focus's repeated for-him language into allocation and use rather than independent ownership.

activation_trace.role: The focus explicitly licenses the labor instead of locating authority in Solomon alone.
Lordship anchors ultimate ownership above the delegated beneficiary.
Capacity and governing authority are explicitly denied as an independent possession.
Ownership and disposal are denied to claimed subordinate powers.
Weight and measure reduce the denied ownership to the smallest accountable scale.
The minute scattered particle marks how exhaustive the ownership denial is.
Partnership and shared title are explicitly excluded.
Permission returns as the sole gate even for intercession.

structural_cues: 34:21-23 repeatedly deny independent authority, ownership, partnership, and support, then preserve permission as the governing exception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies categorical denials and a repeated permission clause; I infer that for Solomon marks entrusted benefit or use. Grammatically it could mark benefit alone without specifying a legal theory of usufruct.

changed_reading.before: Wind, copper, and jinn constitute Solomon's extraordinary possessions.
changed_reading.after: They are allocated capacities held inside divine title: real delegation without any transfer of ultimate ownership or independent power.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the later exposure of jinn as objects of false worship, 34:42 denies every party ownership of benefit or harm and repeats the command to taste punishment. The focus's immediate labor sanction becomes a local-scale enactment of the surah's wider accountability rule.

activation_trace.role: Experienced tasting makes the focus sanction immediate and personal.
The kindled blaze supplies the focus's local punitive image.
Hidden beings reappear as wrongly worshiped agents rather than rightful owners of power.
The denial of ownership removes every creature's independent control over outcome.
Benefit opposed to harm names the outcomes no party can independently confer.
The exact experiential punishment idiom repeats at collective judgment.
Punitive pain carries the focus sanction into the later judgment scene.

structural_cues: 34:41 names jinn worship; 34:42 immediately denies creaturely control and repeats tasting punishment by fire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the jinn sequence and verbal recurrence; I infer that the focus sanction previews the universal judgment pattern. It could instead be a standard punishment formula repeated without typological force.

changed_reading.before: The blaze is a workplace disciplinary threat peculiar to Solomon's jinn.
changed_reading.after: It is also a focused preview of the surah's anti-idolatry judgment: delegated agents cannot own outcomes, and deviation becomes experienced accountability.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the lexical phrase uses eye as a spring, not as a direct claim that the copper source watches. It remains anchored in the packet's attested eye branch, labor before the hands, and the adjacent declaration that work is seen. Downstream prose should present it as a material-metaphoric overlay, never as an alternate translation of the phrase.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عَيْنَ ٱلْقِطْرِ وَمِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ مَن يَعْمَلُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ

activation_trace.role: The spring branch fixes eye as the literal source feeding the foundry.
The bodily eye branch supplies a secondary visibility image within that source.
Work before the hands places production in an exposed supervisory field.
The immediately preceding assertion of seeing work activates inspection around the focus workshop.

changed_reading.before: The molten-metal source feeds a supervised workshop.
changed_reading.after: As a contained overlay, the workshop is also an inspection field: the eye/source, labor before authority, and divine seeing make production legible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because the focus verb is causative flow, while request comes from the packet's explicit secondary mapped root. The split-root activation is still anchored in the supplied inventory and sharpened by the later refusal to ask a wage. Downstream prose must call it an echo of provision or fulfilled need, not parse or translate the focus verb as asking.

activation_trace.role: The secondary mapped branch supplies the image of a need or request being fulfilled beneath the dominant flow sense.
The later refusal to ask anything from the audience sharpens the contrast between grant and extraction.
Payment for work supplies the wage that the messenger explicitly does not demand.

changed_reading.before: God makes a copper source flow for Solomon.
changed_reading.after: As a split-root echo only, the flow also resembles a need fulfilled for him, set against a later mission that extracts no wage from its hearers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it connects physical transport to the closing scenes of failed eschatological reach. It remains anchored in the focus's quantified morning/evening transit and the packet's repeated near, far, reaching, and barrier language. Downstream prose should describe a surah-level contrast in access, not identify wind travel with salvation.

activation_trace.role: Evening travel and return supply successful long-range movement inside a granted cycle.
Month units quantify the extraordinary reach achieved in each daily leg.
Failure of attainment or escape supplies the closing negation of reach.
Nearness becomes the location of seizure rather than an advantage.
Reaching by extension names the access sought too late.
Farness makes the desired reach unavailable.
An intervening barrier finally blocks access to what is desired.

changed_reading.before: Miraculous speed collapses distance for Solomon.
changed_reading.after: Distance collapses only under granted access; without it, reaching from far fails, nearness becomes seizure, and a barrier closes the desired path.

strongest_changes: The focus shifted from three adjacent marvels into a calibrated circulation, foundry, and command system.
The David and Saba sequences made material flow ethically conditional: measured craft and gratitude stabilize abundance, while turning away releases destructive flow.
Solomon's for-him privileges became allocated capacities bounded by permission, with no transfer of ultimate ownership.
The jinn sequence demystified hidden agency by separating visible service from knowledge of the unseen.
Travel became permissioned reachability rather than raw speed: measured access sustains circulation, while desired distance can end in dispersal or failed reach.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence joined flow, work, measurement, before-hands exposure, permission, distance, and tasting into one unusually inspectable mechanism: material engineering and mobility are real powers, but each remains morally, epistemically, and juridically bounded. The packet's split mapping of the flow root also preserved a contained fulfilled-request outlier that a conservative synthesis would likely lose.
remaining_uncertainties: The repeated before-hands construction may form a deliberate spatial-temporal chain, or its occurrences may remain independent idioms.
The controlled copper flow and Saba flood strongly reverse one another at the root level, but the degree of intended hydraulic analogy remains uncertain.
The eye/source and fulfilled-request readings are branch-backed overlays, not alternate lexical translations, and should remain explicitly qualified.
